snippet.title: Mzito 2.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Mzito is a 2D faller platformer adventure game.You play as one of the first two Mzito and go on an epic adventure to save Africa across 15 majestic locations. 
Explore, Discover  Awaken Africa!
Playstore Link : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.WezaInteractiveEntertainment.Mzito
Mzito Blog: http://mzitodevblog.wordpress.com/
